UPDATE jobs SET status = $2, runs = $3, agent_id = $4, error = $5, started_at = $6,
                         finished_at = $7, approval = $8, approved_by = $9, approved_at = $10,
                         rejected_by = $11, rejected_at = $12, checkout = $13,
                         version = version + 1
         WHERE id = $1 RETURNING version
